summary: Frontend retest of the 3 priority fixes. Setup: Playwright at 1920x1080 on the public URL, logged in as cm.coordinator (cm.aftersales for the CRM smoke test). Real AI extraction was used. Seed data was fictional with the TEST_bqui_ prefix and mirrors setup() in test_cm_build_quote_import.py: 1 customer with a sage account, a linked org and site, a rate group, and approved / provisional / two-variant / ineligible / no-tariff configs. One ACTIVE machine with serial BQUI-T-OLD1 was seeded under a live contract. I also added 60 'TEST_bqui Scale Leisure 49xx' companies for the search test. RESULTS: (1) Import of sales invoice SI-BQUI-8812 read 6 lines; the customer was matched by account reference TQACC-5521. The summary read '5 of 6 identified · 1 price approved · 2 need price approval · 1 need a decision · 2 excluded. New machines are added as awaiting installation — not marked installed.' This matches the DB summary and the per-line labels. Approved line: 'Machine matched — Price approved' in green rgb(52,199,89). Provisional line: decision 'Matched (exact code)' plus 'Machine matched — Price requires approval' in amber, NOT 'Needs review'. Variant line: 'Needs review' with LED/Touch buttons. Ineligible line: excluded, 'Not eligible for maintenance'. No-tariff line: 'Maintenance tariff missing'. Old serial: 'Already under contract', excluded. The site was preselected. Use in Build Quote stayed disabled until I chose the Touch variant. (2) Apply showed '5 machine(s) ready to price (0 already on the register, 5 added)'. In the DB all 5 new machines are status pending_installation, lifecycle_stage identified_from_invoice, install_verified false, with no install_date and no warranty_expiry. TEST_bqui_eq-old is still active with install_date 2024-05-01. Re-apply through the API returned equipment_created 0, and the equipment count did not change. (3) Build: confidence REVIEW REQUIRED, 2 exceptions (PROVISIONAL TQBike 20, TARIFF MISSING TQRow), consistent with each other. Save gave AFS-2026-6A3BA (unpriced_count 2). In Contracts > Agreements the row shows '2 unpriced — edit to send', and the Record acceptance, Send to customer and Create link buttons are disabled. The API refuses accept, send-email and portal-link with a 400 and a clear message. (4) Customer search on an unknown-customer invoice: before typing, the dropdown holds only 'Select customer…' (no default list, no suggestions). One character sends no request. Typing fast sends 1 request, for the final text only, and shows 'Searching…' while it loads. The final list matched the latest text exactly (10 × 'Scale Leisure 491x'). Nonsense text shows 'No customers found'. Choosing TEST_bqui Kingfisher set '(chosen by coordinator)', re-matched the line ('2 on register'), set the site and enabled Apply. (5) Regression: Contract Management Agreements and Contracts & Renewals tabs load. The CRM Companies search works. The design is unchanged. ONE MINOR BUG FOUND in the search race; see below.

minor.endpoint: Build Quote result (build-quote-from-estate) vs saved quote
minor.issue: The live result card shows 'AUTO-PRICED (4/5)' and gives the provisional TQBike 20 a price (£ value shown), but the saved quote has unpriced_count=2, because the provisional bike counts as unpriced. The two numbers disagree. Also, the TQRow line in the grouped list says 'RRP req.' while its exception says TARIFF MISSING; the wording should match.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale results show and 'Searching…' disappears for up to 300 ms after a request still loading is aborted. Steps: type a term, wait more than 300 ms so the request starts, then change the text. The aborted request's finally block runs while st.seq still equals its own seq, because seq only goes up when the next timer fires. So setCoLoading(false) runs and the previous query's results stay listed under 'Select customer…' until the new request returns. The final list is still correct. Fix: bump st.seq (or set a flag) at the time of abort/clearTimeout in searchCo, and clear coResults when a new term starts loading.

issues: For excluded lines (ineligible TQVibe, already-covered old serial) the 'Include' option is still enabled. This is minor: I did not check whether apply then accepts an ineligible machine.

action_items: LOW: in DocumentImportCard.searchCo, invalidate st.seq when aborting or clearing the timer so an aborted request cannot clear 'Searching…', and clear stale coResults while a new term loads.
LOW: make the 'Auto-priced x/y' count on the Build Quote result agree with the saved quote's unpriced_count. Provisional machines are counted as priced in the UI but as unpriced on save.
LOW: the grouped line for a TARIFF_MISSING machine shows 'RRP req.'; consider 'Tariff missing'.
OPTIONAL: disable 'Include' for not_eligible lines in the import decision select.
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js is 3,469 lines; DocumentImportCard should be its own module.
In searchCo, the seq guard is incremented inside the timer rather than synchronously. This causes the brief stale/loading flicker described above.
Seed note: test_cm_build_quote_import.py seeds standard_pct=10, while real rate groups store fractions (0.03–0.13). So the TEST prices of £50,000 per machine are a seed artifact, not a pricing bug.

rca of the issue: Search flicker: searchCo calls st.ctrl.abort() synchronously, but st.seq is only incremented when the new debounce timer fires. The aborted request's finally block sees seq === st.seq and runs setCoLoading(false). The old coResults are never cleared. Reproduce: type 'TEST_bqui Scale Leisure 4', wait 350 ms, type '...495', and read the select within 30 ms. You get 'Select customer…' plus the old results instead of 'Searching…'.
